messages:
Maria G.: quick sync: proposing a compatibility-gating + telemetry plan for smart routing -> variant fallbacks. want feedback before i put up a console PR.

Jun K.: sounds good. high-level: are we talking router-side checks (reject/route) or post-handoff monitoring?

Maria G.: router-side before we route to a variant. goal: avoid returning successful but subtly incompatible responses (tokenizer mismatch, context clipping, tool-call schema differences). fallback still allowed but gated.

Omar S.: can you enumerate the concrete incompatibilities we care about? tokenizer vs vocab, context-length, and tool-calling parity?

Maria G.: yep. list: 1) tokenizer token id mapping differences that change prompt/stop behavior. 2) max context shorter than requested -> silent truncation. 3) tool-calling spec mismatch (different param names / missing fields) 4) response format changes (structured JSON vs free-text) 5) special tokens / eos handling.

Priya V.: for 1) and 2) we can detect heuristically before routing: run the minimal encode(pass) for key prompt templates and compare token counts / ids. cheap-ish. for tool-calls we need contract checks.

Jun K.: agree. UX: if routing falls back to a variant that is flagged "compat-risk", console should show a warning banner and allow explicit "force fallback" toggle per-route. default behavior depends on customer tier.

Maria G.: proposed gating modes: 
```
- strict: block fallback for any incompatibility; return 409 with guidance (enterprise default)
- warn: allow fallback but tag call and surface to console/telemetry
- permissive: allow fallback silently (self-serve default)
```
Also add a per-customer opt-in for forced permissive.

Omar S.: telemetry: what metrics do we need? my list: `compatibility_check_passed` (bool), `tokenizer_delta_tokens` (int), `toolcall_schema_mismatch` (enum), `context_truncation_bytes` (int), `fallback_taken` (bool), `user_visible_regressions` (bool via eval probes).

Priya V.: +1. we should also emit sampled request/response diffs (redacted) into a secure bucket when `warn` triggers so SRE/product can triage. retention 90d by default.

Maria G.: good. chart ideas for the console: simple matrix heatmap per model-variant x route showing counts of incompatibilities (by category), and timeline for regressions. add alert: >0.5% user_visible_regressions in 1h -> pager for enterprise.

Jun K.: rollout UX: when a new variant is added to catalog, run automated compatibility audit (test suite of canonical prompts + tool-call mocks). attach audit result to the variant page. default router policy uses audit outcome to set gating level.

Omar S.: one gotcha: tokenizer round-trip checks are nondeterministic across quantized variants. need tolerance thresholds. recommend `token_delta_threshold = 3` tokens by default.

Maria G.: noted. also need to handle mixed-region fallbacks: some regions only have a quantized variant; routing policy should have `region_strictness` so e.g., EU customers can choose stricter or auto-fallback to hosted.

Priya V.: instrumentation detail: add a boolean `compatibility_gating_decision` tag to tracing spans and include `gating_reason` tag with short code (TOkenizerMismatch, ContextShort, ToolcallSchema). helps search.

Jun K.: +1 on tracing tags. also add a console audit log entry for every gating decision (who changed mode, when) for compliance.

SRE-bot: deploy check: compatibility-audit service currently in staging. no infra blockers for basic metrics (prom-metrics + event stream).

Maria G.: plan for next week: 1) add router check harness + small library for encode/token-count diffs 2) PR with gating config schema + default per-tier mapping 3) telemetry proto + dashboards mockups 4) console banner + force-toggle UX. I'll open the PRs and link here.

Jun K.: please include a short migration guide for existing routes (what changes to default behavior).

Priya V.: i'll draft the dashboard mockups after the audit output schema is stable.

Omar S.: i'll prototype the tokenizer delta tool (fast path) and a fuzz test for toolcall schemas.

Maria G.: thanks all. ping me if you want to pair on the canary rules. tagging @deploy-bot for infra readiness. :thumbsup:
